# Vendored JUCE

- Version: **9.0.5** (released 2026-11-02), copied 2026-11-07 from the official release
  zip (`juce-9.0.5-osx.zip`, github.com/juce-framework/JUCE/releases/tag/9.0.5).
- Copied: `CMakeLists.txt`, `LICENSE.md`, `modules/`, `extras/Build/`. Not copied: examples,
  docs, Projucer/DemoRunner apps and other tools.
- Not modified. To upgrade, replace this folder with the same subset of a newer release
  and record the change in docs/DECISIONS.md.
- Licence: JUCE licence (Starter tier while revenue ≤ $20k) or AGPLv3. See LICENSE.md and
  docs/02-architecture.md §2.3. Register the Starter licence before distributing any build.
